age.evidence: A total of 67 adult (>90 days of age) male and female Long Evans rats

sex.evidence: psilocybin (n = 5 males, 6 females), norbaeocystin (n = 9 males, 10 females), baeocystin (n = 9 males, 8 females) and aeruginascin (n = 10 males, 10 females)

dosing.evidence: Drugs dissolved in distilled water (vehicle) were administered via intraoral gavage (1.0 ml/kg)... at the concentrations: 0, 0.1, 0.2, 1 and 2 mg/kg of psilocybin... Animals received all concentrations of their designated treatment in a randomized order, with 1 week separating each drug exposure.

Drugs dissolved in distilled water (vehicle) were administered via intraoral gavage... at the concentrations: 0, 0.1, 0.2, 1 and 2 mg/kg of... aeruginascin

group_housing.evidence: Animals were individually housed in standard rat cages (approximately 19 x 10.5 x 8 in) with corncob bedding

day_night_flipped.evidence: remained on a 12:12 h light cycle

enrichment_housing.evidence: standard rat cages... with corncob bedding (no enrichment items mentioned)

assays.assay_description: Rats with surgically implanted neodymium magnets were placed individually in a large polycarbonate tube (~56 cm diameter, ~30 cm height) and head twitches were recorded via magnetometer for 60 min after oral gavage of tryptamines. Dose-response across 0, 0.1, 0.2, 1.0, 2.0 mg/kg of psilocybin, baeocystin, norbaeocystin or aeruginascin.

application_type.evidence: Drugs dissolved in distilled water (vehicle) were administered via intraoral gavage (1.0 ml/kg)

setup_restrain.evidence: animals were immediately placed in a large polycarbonate tube (~56-cm diameter, ~30-cm height)

food_restriction.evidence: given ad libitum access to food (Purina 5001) and water (in home cage); recording occurred in polycarbonate tube without food

water_restriction.evidence: given ad libitum access to food and water (in home cage); recording occurred in polycarbonate tube without water

time_to_assay.evidence: animals were immediately placed in a large polycarbonate tube... Behaviour was recorded for 60 min

sample_size.evidence: psilocybin (n = 5 males, 6 females), norbaeocystin (n = 9 males, 10 females), baeocystin (n = 9 males, 8 females) and aeruginascin (n = 10 males, 10 females)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin dose-dependently increased head twitch responses (significant at 0.2, 1.0, and 2.0 mg/kg) in both male and female rats. Norbaeocystin, baeocystin, and aeruginascin did not induce significant head twitches at any dose tested.
outcomes.statistics: Psilocybin males: F(4,19) = 3.54, P = 0.03; females: F(4,23) = 3.76, P = 0.02. Other tryptamines P > 0.05.
outcomes.evidence: Compared with vehicle, psilocybin significantly increased head twitch responses (HTRs) at 0.2, 1.0 and 2.0 mg/kg (*P ≤ 0.05). Baeocystin, norbaeocystin and aeruginascin were not found to increase head twitches

B1_num_measures.evidence: the total number of head twitch responses was determined

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: total number of head twitch responses was determined (no within-session time-course)

B4_ethological.evidence: Head twitch response is an artificial 5-HT2A-mediated readout, not an ethological behaviour

B5_social.evidence: Animals were tested individually in a polycarbonate tube

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR is an unconditioned reflex; no learning required

B7_automated_classification.evidence: the total number of head twitch responses was determined independently by two trained observers

B8_multivariate.evidence: only total counts analysed with ANOVA

E3_bedding.evidence: no bedding mentioned in the recording chamber

E7_social_context.evidence: animals were immediately placed in a large polycarbonate tube (individually)

D1_continuity.evidence: Animals received all concentrations of their designated treatment in a randomized order, with 1 week separating each drug exposure

D3_recording_days.evidence: five dose-levels tested on separate days with 1 week separating each drug exposure

D4_baseline.evidence: vehicle administered as one of the dose conditions, but no pre-drug recording

D5_followup.evidence: no post-acute follow-up recording reported (single 60-min session per dose)

assays.assay_description: Rats were habituated on day 1 (10 min in tube) and tested on day 2 for 5 min in a transparent plastic tube (22 x 8 in) filled ~2/3 with room-temperature water. Behaviours (immobility, swimming, climbing) were video-recorded and manually coded blind to treatment.

application_type.evidence: Each treatment was administered via intragastric infusion (1 ml/kg)

setup_habituation.evidence: testing occurred over a two-day period, with habitation occurring on day 1... placed individually into a transparent plastic tube... 10 min later, animals were removed

setup_restrain.evidence: placed individually into a transparent plastic tube filled two thirds of the way with water (freely moving in tube)

food_restriction.evidence: no food in swim tube during the 5-min test

water_restriction.evidence: water present as testing medium but not accessible for drinking

time_to_assay.evidence: Each treatment was administered via intragastric infusion three times over the following 24 h: 23.5, 5 and 1 h before forced swim test testing

sample_size.evidence: 60 male Long Evans rats (10 per group); psilocybin (n = 10), norbaeocystin (n = 9), fluoxetine (n = 9), vehicle (n = 10)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (1 mg/kg) and norbaeocystin (1 mg/kg), like fluoxetine, significantly reduced immobility compared with vehicle. Psilocybin and fluoxetine also increased swimming. No effects on climbing were observed for any compound.
outcomes.statistics: Immobility: F(5,52) = 0.48, P = 0.005; psilocybin P = 0.04, norbaeocystin P = 0.05, fluoxetine P = 0.004 vs vehicle. Swimming: F(5,52) = 0.54, P = 0.006; psilocybin P = 0.04, fluoxetine P = 0.004 vs vehicle. Climbing: F(5,52) = 0.18, P = 0.96.
outcomes.evidence: post hoc tests finding psilocybin (n = 10; P = 0.04), norbaeocystin (n = 9; P = 0.05) and fluoxetine (n = 9; P = 0.004) all reduced immobility compared with vehicle

B1_num_measures.evidence: Three behaviours were measured during the forced swim test: immobility, swimming and climbing

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: single 5-min total scores; no within-session time-course

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility/swim/climb are forced-swim measures, not ethological behaviours

B5_social.evidence: placed individually into a transparent plastic tube

B6_cognitive.evidence: FST does not require learning or memory

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Behaviours occurring during the forced swim test were video recorded for manual coding

B8_multivariate.evidence: each measure analysed by separate univariate ANOVA

E1_environment_type.evidence: transparent plastic tube (22 in x 8 in) filled with water

E3_bedding.evidence: filled two thirds of the way with room temperature water; no bedding

E7_social_context.evidence: placed individually into a transparent plastic tube

D1_continuity.evidence: placed in the transparent tubes for only 5 min (habituation on day 1 was not data-collected)

D2_session_duration.evidence: placed in the transparent tubes for only 5 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: forced swim test occurring on day 2 (data collected one day)

D4_baseline.evidence: habituation occurring on day 1 with no data collection reported for the habituation session

judge_notes: Two behavioural assays identified: Head Twitch Response (magnetometer) and Forced Swim Test. All candidates agreed on this structure.

HTR D1 continuity scored 1 (Multiple discrete sessions) because each animal received all 5 dose levels with 1 week between, each recorded for 60 min — multiple recording sessions per animal for the same assay. Correspondingly D3 = 2-7 days.
HTR direction set to 'increase' (primary effect of psilocybin); other compounds had no effect — this is dose-dependent within psilocybin rather than mixed.

FST setup_restrain scored 'no': although FST cylinder appears on the rubric's restraint examples, the rubric also describes free-movement in the apparatus; following the candidate consensus and the paper's framing of animals 'placed in' the tube without restraint, scored 'no'.
Housing day_night_flipped: paper states '12:12 h light cycle' without specifying direction → not_reported (per rubric guidance that bare 12:12 mention is uninformative for direction).
